questionText: A student scored 45 out of 60. What is the percentage?
If the price of petrol increased by 7%, then by what percentage should the consumption be decreased by the consumer, if the expenditure on petrol remains unchanged?

A reduction of 7.5% in the cost price of a commodity enables a shopkeeper to purchase 15 kg more than what he previously purchased for a sum of ₹7,400. In order to make a profit of 32.5% on the pre-reduction cost price of the commodity, at what price (in ₹) per kg should the commodity be sold?

In an election between two candidates, y% of the voters did not vote. 10% of the votes cast were declared invalid, while all the valid votes were cast in favour of either of the two candidates. The candidate who got 59.375% of the valid votes cast was declared elected by 2484 votes. If the number of people eligible to vote in that election was 16,000, what is the value of y?
solutionText:
Golden rules for is type ke election questions:

Awkward decimal % (jaise 59.375%, 37.5%, 62.5%) ko turant fraction mein convert karo — inme se zyadatar 
/
8
/8, 
/
16
/16, 
/
32
/32 ke clean fractions hote hain.
Winner-loser ka margin fraction seedha nikaalo (winner% − loser% ka fraction), fir diya hua margin-vote-count use karke valid votes ek hi step mein nikaal lo.
Chain backwards: Valid → Cast (÷ validity%) → Eligible (given) → y% seedha subtraction se.

Due to a decrease in manpower, the production in a factory decreased by 12%. By what percentage (rounded off to two decimal places) should the working hours be increased to restore the original
production?

In an election between two candidates, 86% of the registered voters cast their votes, and 20% of the votes cast were found to be invalid. The winning candidate secured 55% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 3,010 votes. How many voters were registered in total?

In an election, 12% of the voters in the voter list did not cast their votes, whereas 84 voters cast their ballot papers blank. There were only two candidates: Ramagya and Shravan. The winner, Ramagya, was supported by 54% of all the voters in the list. He got 1,456 more votes than his rival, Shravan. Find the total number of voters in the list
